hit.sentence: 駅からおよそ十分歩きました。
hit.exEN: I walked for about ten minutes from the station.
hit.taught: 十分 じゅうぶん (the 'enough' reading)
hit.expected: じゅっぷん | じっぷん
hit.note: exEN says minutes, and no 'enough' word appears, so the sense is minutes. Listed in PLAN §I, first addendum (the fix review's own scan). In the pool.

votes.reasoning:
I read n3-b020 in Sources/VocabKit/Resources/n3.json at 3d891b9 and checked it against PLAN-V1.36.md §I (the first addendum lists it as a pool sentence; addendum 2 extends item 4 to 分).

The entry: exJP is 駅からおよそ十分歩きました。 and exEN is "I walked for about ten minutes from the station." exZH agrees: 我从车站大概走了十分钟 (十分钟 = ten minutes). The token is taught as ["十分","じゅうぶん"], and exKana is えきからおよそじゅうぶんあるきました.

The sense is clearly a duration. The headword taught here is およそ ("about, roughly"), and およそ sits directly before a number, its normal use for an approximate count. "およそじゅうぶん歩きました" would mean "walked roughly enough", which makes no sense and matches neither translation. No "enough" sense appears anywhere in the entry.

So the taught じゅうぶん (the "enough" reading) is wrong for this sentence. The right reading for an N3 learner is じゅっぷん or じっぷん, both standard. The taught form is neither, so the rule for two standard forms supports upholding the hit.

Notes for whoever applies the fix:
- The corpus already has one 十分 = "ten minutes" correction, n1-b1516, which uses じっぷん. It is the only 十分 token not read じゅうぶん. For consistency the fix could use じっぷん, or the checker could accept both forms.
- exKana must be changed along with the exTokens reading, or the two will disagree.
- The entry is in the dictation pool. A learner who types what the voice says (じゅっぷん/じっぷん) is currently refused.

This was a read-only check: no files were changed.

votes.reasoning:
I upheld this hit. I checked it read-only against main at 3d891b9.

1. The corpus says what the hit says. In Sources/VocabKit/Resources/n3.json, entry n3-b020 (headword およそ) has the sentence 駅からおよそ十分歩きました。 with the token ["十分","じゅうぶん"]. Its exKana reads えきからおよそじゅうぶんあるきました.

2. The sense is "minutes", not "enough". exEN says "about ten minutes", and exZH says 大概走了十分钟. The sentence itself also points that way: およそ means "approximately", and it needs a quantity after it. 十分 as じゅうぶん ("sufficiently") is not a quantity, so "およそ じゅうぶん 歩きました" makes no sense. Nothing else in the sentence suggests "enough". The likely cause is the tokenizer: on its own, 十分 defaults to the adverb reading じゅうぶん.

3. The taught form matches neither standard form. 10 minutes is read じゅっぷん, or じっぷん in the traditional and textbook form. (じゅうふん and じゅうぷん are not standard.) じゅうぶん is a different word, so it fails the "uphold only if the taught form is neither" test. Beginner textbooks teach じゅっぷん / じっぷん for "10 minutes" at N5, so either is the right reading to teach an N3 learner here.

4. It matters for riders. PLAN-V1.36 §I's first addendum lists n3-b020 in the dictation pool. If the voice says じゅっぷん or じっぷん and a rider types what they hear, they are marked wrong. The plan already treats this as the same class of defect: v1.25 corrected n1-b1516 十分 ("ten minutes") to じっぷん, and §I addendum 2 extends item 4 to the counter 分.

A note for the apply step, not part of the verdict: the repo's earlier fix chose じっぷん, so the same form here would be consistent. Either the token and exKana should then read じっぷん, or both should read じゅっぷん. I made no edits.
